identitySignals: OPEF is the standard abbreviation for the Oakland Public Education Fund, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit in Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 43-2014630)
Life Academy's OUSD donation page says Life Academy accepts direct donations via The Oakland Public Education Fund, matching the agenda item about Life Academy
The organization's website says it is the fiscal sponsor of many OUSD schools and works with OUSD, matching a district contract for classroom and academic programs
research.notes: Agenda text gives only the abbreviation 'OPEF' with no location. Identified via the Life Academy link and OUSD fiscal-sponsor relationship. Address given is the mailing PO Box shown on the website footer. CA entity number and SAM UEI not checked.

profile.summary: A nonprofit that leads the development of community resources in Oakland public schools. It raises money for schools, places volunteers in classrooms, and acts as a fiscal sponsor (holds and manages funds) for education projects, including many Oakland Unified School District schools.

review.notes: OPEF is the Oakland Public Education Fund, which the Life Academy OUSD page names as its donation intermediary and which describes itself as a fiscal sponsor for OUSD schools, fitting a Measure N Life Academy item. Summary, contact details (generic info@ email, phone, PO Box mailing address), EIN and Oakland location are all confirmed on the org website and ProPublica.
